# Sarowar Alamgir

Sarowar Alamgir (Bengali: সরোয়ার আলমগীর) is a bangladeshi politician and businessman. A member of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is the CEO of Halda Group.
Political life
He will contest in 2026 Bangladeshi general election from Chittagong-2 constituency.
He was accused of loan default and his candidacy for the 2026 Bangladeshi general election was cancelled, and he withdrew his candidacy by order of the Supreme Court.
